blogs.title: 10 principles for good (sound) design – inspired by Dieter Rams
blogs.content: Audio branding strategist Karsten Kjems has taken Dieter Rams’ 10 principles for good design from the 1970s and rewritten each one to cover sound - including confirmation tones, alerts, and that fake shutter click.
